summary: Frontend-only test of the MPA inventory overlap check and the PROV and on-board badges, done as the Pro user. Seed: a custom meal list 'TEST_Overlap Meals' (1. Dinner rice bowl: 200g rice, 2 eggs. 2. Breakfast toast: 2 slices bread, 1 tbsp butter). Provisions: Milk, Salt, Coffee, Rice, Tea, Sugar. Food areas: 'Main Galley Cupboard' (Salt, Coffee x2, Rice), 'Fridge' (Coffee, Eggs x6) and 'Main Galley Cupboard Under Starboard Settee' (Sugar). Non-food area: 'TEST_Bosun Locker' (Milk x4). Logic: ALL PASS. (1) Run with aisles off and provisions on (the AI amounts call worked): Milk, Salt, Coffee, Tea and Sugar each show a blue PROV badge (curved arrow, text PROV, title 'From your Provisions list'). Rice matches a recipe ingredient, so it is merged into 'Rice – 600 g · 1 on board' with no PROV badge and the green 'Main Galley Cupboard' badge. Salt shows PROV plus 'Main Galley Cupboard'. Coffee shows PROV plus 'Main Galley Cupboard +1' with the title 'Already on board: Main Galley Cupboard, Fridge'. Milk (only in the non-food area) has no on-board badge. Eggs show 'on board already' as a ticked row with the Fridge badge. Meal squares render, the first row reads 'Meals (2) from TEST_Overlap Meals', the types warning dialog came up and 'Make it anyway' worked. Badges are still there after a reload. (2) Run with aisles on and both Meal Plan and TEST_Overlap Meals picked: the MP/TM source tags render. Milk merges with the Meal Plan milk, with no PROV and no on-board badge. Sugar merges with the recipe sugar, with no PROV and the long area badge. Coffee and Tea sit under Pantry and Salt under Herbs with PROV badges. The '· N on board' notes are correct. There are no page errors. LAYOUT BUG at 390px: the row with the long area name 'Main Galley Cupboard Under Starboard Settee' does NOT truncate. The on-board badge runs to x=380 while the row's edit button starts at x=281, so it goes under the edit/delete buttons. The item text span is 281px wide inside a 182px column, which also pushes the PROV badge over the pencil icon, and the li overflows by 7px. The page itself has no horizontal overflow. At 1920px everything wraps cleanly with no overlap.

ui_bugs.issue: At 390px a long Food area name does not truncate with an ellipsis. The badge (and the PROV badge on the same row) overflows under the edit/delete icon buttons. The truncate span's scrollWidth equals its clientWidth (247px), and the badge's right edge is at 380 while the edit button's left edge is at 281.

action_items: Fix the badge overflow on mobile. RCA: in Checklist.jsx Row, the text column is `flex min-w-0 flex-col items-start`. Because of items-start, its child `.item-text` sizes to its min-content. That min-content includes the nowrap truncate text in OnBoardBadge, so the span becomes wider (281px) than the column (182px), and `max-w-full` on MpaText and the badge has no effect because their parent is already too wide. Verified fix (injected in the browser): add `max-width: 100%` to `.item-text` (e.g. className 'item-text max-w-full' on line 40, or in the App.css .item-text rule). After that, the badge truncates to 148px with an ellipsis and ends exactly at the edit button (281).
critical_code_review_comments: mpa.js foodStock: `Number(i.qty) || 1` counts an item with qty 0 as 1 on board, so it still takes stock off and shows the badge. Use `i.qty ?? 1`, or skip items whose qty is 0.
Area names are copied into item.mpa.areas when the list is made, so renaming or deleting an area later leaves old badges until the list is made again. This is acceptable, but worth knowing.
MpaText only shows badges while the label still equals mpaLabel(m). After a user edits a row, the PROV and on-board badges disappear. This matches the existing design for source tags.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (all logic and badge checks pass; the mobile truncation/overlap layout check fails)
